title: Book Three · Chapter 119: The Other Hand
story:
During the winter holiday, rain keeps the football field wet for days.

On Saturday afternoon, Kai comes to Ronan's home with a dry ball. Anna and Lin arrive a little later.

Mum has finished with her last customer. She takes her tea to her own chair near the window.

“The ball stays outside,” she tells Kai.

“It is very clean.”

“So is my floor.”

He leaves it beside Ronan's blue bike.

Inside, they have paper, four pencils, and no clear idea for a game. Then Lin takes a pencil in her left hand.

“Draw with the other hand. We must guess the thing.”

Her first picture has two circles and a long seat.

“A bicycle,” Kai says.

“Too easy.”

“For us. Not for the pencil.”

Anna takes the next turn. She draws a cup with a handle. The handle is larger than the cup.

Ronan points to it. “You can put your whole arm through.”

“It is for very cold hands.”

He takes the pencil and tries a shoe. The front rises. The back grows round. One line goes far beyond the edge.

Kai looks at it carefully.

“A duck.”

“No.”

“A duck with a long problem.”

Anna bends closer. Then she laughs so hard that her pencil rolls off the table.

“It is a shoe,” she says.

Ronan lifts one foot as proof. Kai looks from the foot to the page.

“Wear the duck. It can swim home.”

Mum looks up from her tea. Ronan shows her the picture.

She studies it for a moment.

“The duck is better.”

Lin wipes her eyes and starts another page.

They play until there are pictures across half the table. Kai draws something nobody can name. At last he turns the sheet over and writes: an egg.

“With corners?” Anna asks.

“A strong egg.”

The rain becomes softer beyond the door. Mum finishes her tea and moves to her sewing basket.

The four gather their pictures. Anna asks to keep Ronan's shoe. He signs the bottom with his usual hand.

“Now I know the artist,” she says.

Outside, Kai takes his ball from beside the bike. Lin opens her umbrella. Anna puts the shoe picture safely inside her notebook.

Ronan walks with them to the green door. He looks up at the grey sky.

“No ducks yet.”

Anna gives his arm a light push. Then she goes under Lin's umbrella, and Kai carries the clean ball along the wet street.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

guess＝猜；handle＝把手；proof＝证明、实物依据；artist＝画这幅画的人、艺术家。

## 理解问题

1. 四人怎样玩画画游戏？Ronan画的鞋为什么引来笑声？
2. Anna最后拿走什么？Kai的球最后由谁带走？

## 读句子

**He signs the bottom with his usual hand.**

拆开看：He / signs the bottom / with his usual hand.

他／在画的底部签名／用平常惯用的那只手。
